Contraindications 
β Blockers

Repeat Trop  & ECG at 3 hours (HS) or 6

Repeat ECG if pain / vital signs change 
The HEART Score for Chest Pain in the ED 
History 
* Highly suspicious 
* 2 points 
* Moderately suspicious 
* 1 point 
* Slightly / non-suspicious 
* 0 points 
ECG 
* Significant ST depression 
* 2 points 
* Nonspecific repolarisation 
* 1 point 
* Normal 
* 0 points 
Age 
* ≥ 65 years 
* 2 points 
* > 45 - < 65 years 
* 1 point 
* ≤ 45 years 
* 0 points 
Risk Factors 
* ≥ 3 risk factors 
* 2 points 
* 1 or 2 risk factors 
* 1 point 
* No risk factors 
* 0 points 
Troponin 
* ≥ 3 x normal limit 
* 2 points 
* > 1 - < 3 x normal limit 
* 1 point 
* ≤ normal limit 
* 0 points 
Risk Factors: Diabetes Mellitus, current or recent (<1 month) smoker, 
Hypertension, Hypercholestrolaemia, Family History, Obesity 
Score 0 - 3 (low risk) 
2.5% MACE over next 6 weeks 
Score 4 - 6 (intermediate risk) 
20.3% MACE over next 6 weeks 
Score 7 - 10 (high risk) 
72.7% MACE over next 6 weeks 
MACE = Major Adverse Cardiac Event 
Refer to Int med/Cardiology 
Delta Trop or ECG changes? 
YES 
STAT > 23ng/L 
 
Acute ACS - Delta trop: 
>20 % OR >10ng/L change (rise & fall, at 
least 1 above upper limit or normal) 
 
STATLAB Trop I (not high sensitivity): 
23ng/L is UPPER LIMIT OF NORMAL 
Causes of positive troponin: 
ACS, CCF, PE, Aortic aneurysm, renal 
failure, hypoxia, hypoperfusion, trauma, 
sepsis, stroke and more
